profile.headline: Software Engineer | React, Typescript, C#, .NET, Blazor, JavaScript, Vue, CSS, Tailwind, UI/UX
profile.summary:
Software development brings together many of the things I’m passionate about: problem-solving, creativity, and collaboration. I enjoy tackling challenges, figuring out how to make something work, and transforming complex data from API endpoints into visually appealing, user-friendly interfaces.

I’m driven by the opportunity to create functional and efficient products. Whether it’s optimizing code to reduce redundancies, implementing PRDs and designs into fully realized applications, or improving the user experience, I take pride in delivering high-quality solutions. Collaboration is at the heart of what I do—I value working alongside talented teams to bring ideas to life.

Outside of work, I enjoy reading, playing pickleball, practicing yoga, playing games, and spending time with my family.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Frontend Development Expertise: Skilled in React (TypeScript) and Blazor, building and enhancing scalable web applications.
-Modernization & Migration: Led efforts to rebuild Blazor functionality in React, requiring deep knowledge of both frameworks and ensuring a seamless transition.
-Integration with RESTful APIs: Work extensively with RESTful APIs to fetch and manage data, ensuring efficient communication between frontend and backend services.
-Admin Tools & Internal Applications: Develop and maintain critical admin tools, improving operational workflows and efficiency.
-Localization & Globalization: Assisted in localizing platforms to support a diverse, international user base.
-Agile Development: Operate within a Scrum environment, utilizing Jira for planning, tracking, and delivering high-quality features.
-Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product Management to define Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) and translate them into intuitive, user-friendly applications
-(Company formerly known as Engage Technologies)

positions.title: Student
positions.description:
-Over 500 hours of coding experience, learning HTML, Javascript, CSS, Node.js, Vue.js, mongoDB, Postman, C#, mySQL.
-Learned and implemented Agile/Scrum Methodologies.
-Built full stack applications solo, with a partner, and in groups from start to finish.
